title: Tokyo Electron poised to log record profit on AI momentum: CFO
key_facts: Tokyo Electron expects about 1 trillion yen operating profit for the year ending March 2027.
About 60% growth and a record; previous record 697.3 billion yen (FY to March 2025).
CFO Hiroshi Kawamoto: customer investment momentum stronger than at full-year results.
Samsung was 15.1% of revenue last fiscal year, overtaking TSMC at 12.9%.
Reported by Businesskorea citing Nikkei on 6 Aug.
quote_evidence: Tokyo Electron, Japan's largest semiconductor manufacturing equipment maker, is expected to post consolidated operating profit of 1 trillion yen.
Customer investment momentum is growing stronger than it was at the time of our full-year earnings announcement.
Tokyo Electron has characterized current demand as genuine underlying demand rather than speculative buying.
why_it_matters_hint: Equipment makers see strong chip investment.
